shared_elements: procession of standing human figures in profile
figures holding hands or leading one another
long robed and short-tunic figure types
justification: Both show the same distinctive scheme: files of profile human figures in tall cylindrical headdresses, an usher leading a delegation by the hand, carried vessels and led animals, all stacked in horizontal registers separated by rosette bands. The only differences are of viewpoint and extent—A is a close frontal view of one register while B shows several registers obliquely—not of depicted content.
